agreement_definition: Codex agreement with a published Claude proposal is review concurrence only; amendments/additions are not represented as accepted by Claude or by the Product owner.

claude_loan_ids.title: Unauthorized mutation remains an effect
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Tighten refused_effect evidence to establish that no mutation began within the material effect boundary. Preserve actual or uncertain unauthorized effects under the existing effect/recovery law.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Base not_effected concerns failure to attain the intended outcome, not universal absence of effects. Do not claim the existing core generally permits repetition. Change the profile evidence condition; keep three effect values.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: A refusal is lawful but an unauthorized mutation occurred or remains possible: refusal cannot establish mutation absence.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: UX carries unresolved command outcomes
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Require a typed outcome family representing every materially possible observed or unresolved effect case, with correlation, recovery and replay coverage, using base effect predicates.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: A lost/failed transport response alone does not decide completion; other sufficient observations may already decide it. Base success/failure fields do not forbid richer messages. M1 and M2 consume the same generic owner and are not circular prerequisites.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Replay of completion_unknown can pass while external completion remains unresolved; observe the owning state before dependent repetition.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Qualify the blanket reuse prohibition
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Anti-pattern 11 prohibits inherited reliance after a change without an established applicability relation, not all reuse of a predecessor verdict.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Our original family-level review missed this exact contradicting consumer sentence. Preserve the existing generic reuse owners.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: An unrelated change leaves old arithmetic evidence applicable while a changed fixture invalidates another test.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Event log only when the binding requires one
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Record the admitted execution basis on the selected durable work carrier, including an event log where the execution binding requires it.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Preserve durable evidence and result requirements; environment neutrality does not waive adopted software/event obligations.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Human execution uses a signed register without an event stream; a software binding that requires events still acquires them.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Calculus acknowledges imported result owners
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Replace the sole-normative-authority sentence with calculus specialization ownership plus explicit consumption of FOUNDATIONS result and conjunction law.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: The actual calculus laws already consume those owners. This reconciles the head ownership claim; it creates no new result owner or Judgment record. Track any affected predecessor exclusive-ownership claim separately.
claude_loan_ids.receiving_owner: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS lead; FOUNDATIONS retains result ownership
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: AC-007 and AC-019 resolve to the same core owners before and after the wording repair.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Map the material repricing decision
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Preserve retained/superseded/deferred/withdrawn as obligation states. Separately define the material authorized decision establishing that disposition, its exact predicate and domain refinement into the core.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: TICKETS owns this repricing refinement; it must not reuse ACTIVATION candidate-acceptance as the predicate. The current blanket exemption from the core is inadequate. Our earlier F13 retain decision missed that defect.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: A lawful deferral decision can be established while delivery remains failed or outstanding. An unauthorized withdrawn label cannot close an obligation.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Route design diagnosis to the actual owner
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Keep the 56 review questions. An unanswered required relation withholds its conformance claim; diagnosis follows evidence to the relevant owner.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Our earlier F17 no-proven-gain conclusion missed the categorical coupling/imperative diagnosis at the end of the review questions.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Missing authority or observation cannot establish excessive coupling or imperative design.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Clarify reuse pointers and RF-005
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Explain that RF-005 addresses evaluation on the wrong required basis, and route reuse/current reliance to the existing applicability owners. Add those pointers to the Executive sentences.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Replace basis advance alone invalidates nothing with: advancement does not rewrite the historical result; reliance on the new subject/basis requires established applicability, and affected reliance is withdrawn until established. Scope clarification is defensible; do not automatically count three new semantic replacements.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Preserve historical result while invalidating reliance affected by a changed fixture, basis coordinate or capability.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Defect reporter versus repair author
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Reporting a defect/counterexample or already-required behavior does not itself author the realized subject. Contributing adopted wording, policy or design does.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Qualify may assess the repair by the existing authority, authorship and evidence-independence conditions. Reporting required behavior must not be equated with authoring/directing a particular repair.
claude_loan_ids.change_kind: application clarification of existing independence law
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: A reporter rechecks a failure case; an author of adopted replacement wording needs another assessor for that contribution.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Keep intake classification unresolved when necessary
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Procedure enters universal intake triage and keeps classification open until evidence supports a lawful class.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: The actual triage owner already supplies this behavior. Correct donor citation is SPEC_METHOD 3433-3444, especially 3435-3441.
claude_loan_ids.receiving_owner: SPEC_METHOD procedures consume universal intake triage
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: An incomplete report enters triage without inventing a lawful change classification.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Evidence reuse route and bounded acquisition
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Provide ordinary task entry to the existing evidence-reuse owners and adequate bounded acquisition for that task.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Choose a new frame, an extension, or direct subsection acquisition from task evidence. Claude itself offers the smaller stale-summary extension; do not prescribe an estimated 75-90 KB new frame before measuring need.
claude_loan_ids.receiving_owner: README and frame inputs; existing owners decide reuse
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Fresh actor performs change-impact/reuse task without private context; record acquisition and preserved distinctions.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Task rows stop at the deciding subsection
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Add direct subsection routes for lawful work versus outcome, meaning of a test result, and core values/conjunction. Mark family tables as traces.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Exact anchoring does not waive acquisition of material coupled owners.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Outcome/test/conjunction tasks reach the actual deciding clause without a full unrelated section read.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Show available frames alongside routes
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Link an applicable existing frame when one serves the task; repair the two omitted existing frames.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: A route without a suitable frame may name direct owning sections. A frame column must not force a new frame for every route.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Acceptance-release and member-build-assess are discoverable; a direct-owner route remains lawful.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Intake, ambiguity and carrier acquisition
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Cover intake, ambiguity, carrier selection and test-case authority through a useful bounded entry.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Treat an 80-95 KB intake-triage frame as one candidate. Compare precise owner routes and smaller compositions on the same S1/S4/S6 tasks. Being below 160 KB alone is not qualification.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Actors preserve unresolved classification and test-case authority with less needless acquisition under matched conditions.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Deciding head paragraphs before trace tables
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Add short routing heads before the F22/F2/F11/F13 tables, pointing to deciding subsections.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: These heads locate law, not summarize a second normative rule. Regenerate affected selected excerpts and digests.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: A reader reaches the requested owner without treating its derivation table as an operative answer.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Six-condition admissibility route
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Consider an additional route to existing admissibility owners only if a concrete task still benefits after R2/R5.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Claude reports no fixed trace for this row. Do not introduce TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY, a second owner or a mandatory six-check workflow. Not part of the unconditional baseline loan set.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: A matched admission task gains reliable distinctions or lower acquisition without extra reconciliation.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Complete reviewed-package identity
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Freeze the actual new reviewed baseline package and compare complete membership plus every member byte/digest, with exact declared coordinate exceptions.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Adapt the behavior to the successor. The donor RC9 label-only whitelist is specific to its relabeling, not a ban on the selected semantic changes.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Unchanged package passes; altered, extra, missing or duplicate member fails.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Construction-metadata hygiene
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Remove stale status and reject forbidden construction metadata under the selected publication policy.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Do not blanket-ban every Author/Status/Date/Revision or generated_at occurrence across templates, examples and domain records. Donor regex is package-specific with attribution rules; adapt a scoped check.
claude_loan_ids.receiving_owner: Release surface check; README status repair
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Stale candidate status is flagged; legitimate template fields and historical attribution are not silently deleted.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Declared member/path/JSON checks
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Parse all declared JSON, validate admitted member/path kinds, and detect unresolved references. Apply selected whitespace policy separately.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Donor checks is_file before is_symlink, so its all-symlinks claim is too broad. Define treatment of broken and directory symlinks explicitly. Whitespace is not semantic qualification; scope excludes deferred representation products.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Malformed JSON, unresolved reference, forbidden file link, broken link and directory link receive the declared handling.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Authenticate helper closure before execution
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Use a pinned trusted launcher or authenticated frozen snapshot to verify the selected helper closure before imports/execution.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: RC9 package.py imports context/build_interpretation before its helper authentication. The donor library loader authenticates first, but the claimed whole bootstrap guarantee is not established. Adapt the guarantee rather than copy the implementation claim.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: A modified helper cannot execute before its mismatch is detected; pin the launcher and expected input manifest too.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Retired-owner reference lint
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Report Claude-specific retired-owner phrases for review, distinguishing live normative references from intended history.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: Advisory only: a lexical match is not automatic semantic failure or rewrite authority. Donor ownership_signals collects matches, but the current check_package receipt omits that collection; the adapted lint must expose its findings. Agreement is with the proposed advisory behavior, not the claim that current RC9 already reports it.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Stale live route is reported; quoted predecessor name remains identified as history.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Structured non-body source coverage
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Extend the machine conservation account to the exact historical non-body population with scope and disposition preserved.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: The 55 rows are 10 compression, 2 schema, 24 template, 1 licence, 17 plugin, 1 release note. Keep compression work separately scoped/deferred; work deferral is not semantic not applicable. Derive populations rather than hard-code 55.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: All selected members are accounted for; excluded delivery does not manufacture nonapplicability or acceptance.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

claude_loan_ids.title: Structured successor relations
claude_loan_ids.normalized_proposal: Record changed meaning, predecessor identity, replacement loci, standing, owner-decision reference, remaining condition and dependencies, retaining original prose/evidence.
claude_loan_ids.amendment_or_limit: This improves the conservation evidence carrier, not the distributed standards schemas. A complete structure cannot certify its meaning or mark pending replacements accepted.
claude_loan_ids.discriminating_case: Each changed claim has a receiving-line-specific relation; pending owner decisions remain pending.
claude_loan_ids.standing: proposal-level review only; no implementation or owner acceptance

R1-R5 and stale entry/status repairs. Select useful bounded acquisition instead of prescribing a frame for every route.
M3/P1/R1. Repair the actual prohibition and pointers; drop duplicate generic historical-evidence/testing-reuse law.
A1: lawful capability stop and bounded attention in the Executive cycle; omitted from Claude list.
M1/M2 become explicit consumer repairs. Drop extra ODD/traversal/core restatements; retain rollback/lost-response cases as validation.
P2, subject to existing authority and independence conditions.
M4 corrects carrier applicability. Broad label rewriting has no demonstrated baseline benefit; retain environment-neutral owner law.
A2 only. Currentness, predictive/outcome distinction and supported absence already have base owners; retain cases, withdraw duplicate law.
ODD currentness, target binding before invocation, recovery and retained outer obligation are already owned. Keep regression cases; alternate closure predicate remains separate.
Repair exact exclusive-ownership sentence. Retain fidelity cases as verification material; no new faithful-projection section or Judgment signature.
Posting/writing rules already inherit exact references, result law and conservation. Short pointers only if a reader test demonstrates need.
R6 after R2/R5, only with demonstrated task benefit.
A4: starter computational/execution bindings and current-input/bounded-attention fields, preserving optional-profile guards.
A5: exact-basis member/anchor resolution, additive refresh routes and installed identity verification, without a_c dependency.
